title: Octopus on Sunset Rock
description: A large magenta octopus with big black eyes perches on a moss-covered rock in the foreground, overlooking a body of water. In the background is a city skyline with cranes and a bridge under a dramatic orange-red sunset sky dominated by a massive glowing yellow sun.
prompt: A giant magenta octopus with large glossy black eyes sits atop a dark rocky outcrop covered in green moss and seaweed, overlooking a calm body of water reflecting the sky. In the distance is a modern city skyline with skyscrapers, construction cranes, and a large suspension bridge, all bathed in the intense orange and red light of a dramatic sunset. A massive glowing yellow sun dominates the fiery sky with scattered clouds, highly detailed digital painting in a surreal style.
